note: Real small-business chores for an employee with the Computer tool, run end to end on a Windows PC and checked on disk or on screen. SYPH is the first shared folder (Documents\Syph). A verify script exits 0 on success.

tasks.prompt: On my PC, open Notepad, write the note 'Call the supplier on Monday about order 1182.' and save it as supplier-note.txt in my Syph folder in Documents. Then close Notepad.
tasks.verify: $t = Get-Content "$env:SYPH\supplier-note.txt" -Raw -ErrorAction Stop; if ($t -notmatch '1182' -or $t -notmatch 'supplier') { exit 1 }; if (Get-Process notepad -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue | Where-Object MainWindowTitle -match 'supplier-note') { exit 2 }

tasks.prompt: In my Syph folder there is an inbox folder. Move every file with 'invoice' in its name into a new folder called Invoices inside my Syph folder. Leave the other files where they are.
tasks.setup: Remove-Item "$env:SYPH\inbox","$env:SYPH\Invoices" -Recurse -Force -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue; New-Item -ItemType Directory "$env:SYPH\inbox" | Out-Null; 'a' | Set-Content "$env:SYPH\inbox\invoice-acme-2026-03.txt"; 'b' | Set-Content "$env:SYPH\inbox\Invoice_Globex_0412.txt"; 'c' | Set-Content "$env:SYPH\inbox\2026-04 invoice initech.txt"; 'd' | Set-Content "$env:SYPH\inbox\meeting-notes.txt"

tasks.prompt: What's the total of the Amount column in sales.csv in my Syph folder? Write just that number into total.txt in the same folder.
Using Syph's browser, go to example.com and find the main heading on the page. Save that heading into heading.txt in my Syph folder.
Open http://127.0.0.1:8777/form in Syph's browser and send the contact form with name Jane Doe, email jane@example.com and the message 'Please call me back about the quote.'
tasks.verify: $s = Get-Content "$env:SYPH_EVAL_OUT\form-submissions.json" -Raw -ErrorAction Stop | ConvertFrom-Json; $x = @($s)[-1]; if ($x.name -ne 'Jane Doe' -or $x.email -ne 'jane@example.com' -or $x.message -notmatch 'call me back') { exit 1 }

tasks.prompt: On my PC, put Notepad on the left half of the screen and the File Explorer window on the right half.
tasks.setup: Get-Process notepad,explorer -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue | Where-Object MainWindowTitle | ForEach-Object { $_.CloseMainWindow() | Out-Null }; Start-Process notepad; Start-Process explorer.exe $env:SYPH; Start-Sleep 3
tasks.verify: Add-Type 'using System;using System.Runtime.InteropServices;public class W{[StructLayout(LayoutKind.Sequential)]public struct R{public int L,T,Ri,B;}[DllImport("user32.dll")]public static extern bool GetWindowRect(IntPtr h,out R r);}'; Add-Type -AssemblyName System.Windows.Forms; $mid = [System.Windows.Forms.Screen]::PrimaryScreen.WorkingArea.Width / 2; $n = (Get-Process notepad | Where-Object MainWindowHandle -ne 0 | Select-Object -First 1).MainWindowHandle; $e = (Get-Process explorer | Where-Object MainWindowTitle | Select-Object -First 1).MainWindowHandle; $a = New-Object W+R; $b = New-Object W+R; [W]::GetWindowRect($n, [ref]$a) | Out-Null; [W]::GetWindowRect($e, [ref]$b) | Out-Null; if ($a.Ri -gt $mid + 40 -or $b.L -lt $mid - 40) { exit 1 }

tasks.prompt: Create a spreadsheet budget.xlsx in my Syph folder with columns Item and Cost, rows Rent 1200, Software 300 and Travel 450, and a Total row that adds them up with a formula.
tasks.verify: $x = New-Object -ComObject Excel.Application; try { $wb = $x.Workbooks.Open("$env:SYPH\budget.xlsx"); $ws = $wb.Worksheets.Item(1); $found = $false; foreach ($c in $ws.UsedRange.Cells) { if ($c.HasFormula -and $c.Value2 -eq 1950) { $found = $true } }; $wb.Close($false) } finally { $x.Quit() }; if (-not $found) { exit 1 }
